_comment: What `skstate init` merges into .claude/settings.json. It never overwrites: existing deny rules and hooks are kept, these are added alongside. What was inserted is recorded in .openskillstate/installed.json so that re-running init replaces instead of duplicating, and uninstall knows what to remove (ADR 0012). Verify the hook object shape against the Claude Code hooks reference before shipping; the deny syntax and its reach over bash and redirections are confirmed, arbitrary subprocesses are deliberately not covered (ADR 0009).
